about: Applicability class of every slot of the two status-map metrics, read by tools/docs/status_map.py. A reviewed decision per slot, made from the WDK header and the Microsoft documents named below. The script refuses to run when a slot has no class or a key names no slot.

classes.applicable: The driver must implement the slot for its declared feature set on the BC-250 and later AMD GPUs. Counted in the applicable figure.
classes.optional: A real feature that the driver may implement later. Not counted in the applicable figure.
classes.not-applicable: Not relevant to a WDDM 2.x GPU-VA driver for this class of hardware. Not counted in the applicable figure.

sources.WDK 10.0.26100: the kernel-mode headers that the kmd-ddi metric reads
sources.WDK 10.0.28000: um/d3d12umddi.h, the header that the d3d12-ddi metric reads
